title: Circuit breakers pause failing calls
summary: A circuit breaker stops repeated calls to a service that is failing. Later it allows a small trial to see whether recovery happened.
introduction: A circuit breaker stops repeated calls to a service that is failing. Later it allows a small trial to see whether recovery happened. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain circuit breakers pause failing calls
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A circuit breaker stops repeated calls to a service that is failing. Later it allows a small trial to see whether recovery happened.

blocks.code:
Several Catalog calls fail
Breaker opens: new calls fail fast
After a pause: allow one trial call
blocks.title: Circuit breakers pause failing calls

blocks.text: Failing fast avoids building a long queue of waiting calls. The trial helps detect recovery.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Draw open, trial and closed states.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A circuit breaker does not repair the failed service.
For more detail later, use this [Microservices further reading](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/architecture/microservices/).
